rows.effect: Correlation-only evaluation authorizes many unsupported topology, direction, structure-function, and mechanistic claims.
Weighted compensation reintroduces unsupported claim authorization.
Mechanistic claims can pass when topology evidence is missing.
Mechanistic claims can pass when direction is not identified.

rows.removed_condition: force every borderline claim into supported/blocked
rows.effect: Uncertainty is needed to report supported claims that become unstable under local evidence perturbations.

rows.removed_condition: use lexical citation overlap without retrieval/rationale separation
rows.effect: SciFact shows that evidence retrieval and support classification must be reported separately from lexical overlap.

rows.removed_condition: allow correlation to authorize causal direction
rows.effect: Tuebingen supports causal-overclaiming control, but not a causal-discovery performance claim.

rows.removed_condition: do not audit text against executable claim contracts
rows.effect: The current manuscript can be checked directly for unsupported wording.

interpretation: The ablation does not claim that ClaimBench is a better predictor or causal discovery method. It shows that removing claim-gate components reintroduces unsupported scientific wording or removes the ability to audit it.
